summary.text: Celeste Cairns is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 13 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia describes her as an accountant and former CPA, and the General Assembly lists her as a House Deputy Majority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Cairns was born in Valdosta, Georgia, and lives in Emerald Isle, North Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Georgia.
Her career included work as a CPA with Deloitte and in the audit and consulting departments of Willis Corroon Corporation and HCA Healthcare Corporation.
Cairns succeeded Republican Patricia McElraft in House District 13, which the General Assembly lists as covering Carteret and Craven counties.

She chairs the House Alcoholic Beverage Control Committee and is vice chairman of the Commerce and Economic Development Committee and of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources.
